STEP 1 - Scene: The photo shows a small white bowl filled with sliced (flaked) almonds, lit strongly from above. It is a snack or ingredient rather than a full meal.

STEP 2 - Vessel: This looks like a small, deep white bowl. Its outer diameter is about 12 cm and the inner opening about 10 cm. Using the inner diameter, area = 3.14 × 5² ≈ 79 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: The only visible food is sliced almonds. There is no oil, dressing or sauce.

STEP 4 - Area: The almonds cover about 100% of the bowl's inner area.

STEP 5 - Volume: The bowl looks deep and the almonds sit fairly high, so I estimate the pile depth at about 4 cm. Gross volume = 79 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 316 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Sliced almonds are loose flakes with a lot of air between them. Their bulk density is about 0.3 g/ml, lower than the generic categories, so I use that value. 316 ml × 0.3 ≈ 95 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Almonds provide about 580 kcal per 100 g. 95 g × 5.8 ≈ 551 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A small bowl of almond flakes weighing roughly 80–110 g is plausible.
